expected_result: Recorded against the transitional lint policy, not against zero problems.
title: Repository-wide lint baseline
description: Full ESLint run recorded as a debt baseline. Existing debt is tracked; it is not represented as a pass.
actual_result: 730 problems across 115 files: 716 errors, 14 warnings, 711 auto-fixable.
supports: The repository-wide lint problem count at the declared input set, recorded as quality debt.
does_not_support: That the repository is lint-clean, that formatting equals correctness, or that any defect class is absent.
